items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I played with him in 1921. 1921 on the boat.

ctx.x: Yeah, I wouldn't mind a little cup of coffee. If you have an extra cup then. Sure. What do you want in it? Just a little sugar and cream. See, we had one of the first swing bands in Chicago, you know. Worked with Sig Meyer and some hands off. It was a good band. How big was the band? How much sugar do you want? One and a half, right? One, two, three, five, seven, ten pieces. Sig Meyer, he played the violin, he was the leader. It was a very good band. Was it a reading band arrangements and so on? Oh yes. You know…
Who? Wrath. You know the guitar player? Oh, I didn't know that. Yeah, because he used to play with George. He used to play with a big, heavy-shaped guy. Oh, I didn't know that. He played a long bass.
I played with him in 1921. 1921 on the boat.
